tweaks.description: Lets your phone start Android Auto or Apple CarPlay over the car's own Wi-Fi, without a cable. It also restarts wireless Android Auto by itself if it gets stuck after the car's Wi-Fi hotspot has been used. Takes effect after the head unit restarts, and turning it off brings back the cable-only setup.
